title: fix(anthropic): record token usage from streamed responses

@@ -197,6 +197,7 @@ def process_stream_chunk(api_response_chunk)
         when :message_start
           api_message = Anthropic::Transforms.gem_to_hash(api_response_chunk.message)
           self.message_stack.push(api_message)

@@ -239,6 +240,15 @@ def process_stream_chunk(api_response_chunk)
           self.message_stack.last.merge!(delta)
           self.stream_finish_reason = delta[:stop_reason] if delta[:stop_reason]
 
+          # message_delta carries the cumulative output tokens (and, on newer
+          # API versions, refreshed input counts); layer them over the usage
+          # message_start reported so the turn keeps a single running total.
+          delta_usage = Anthropic::Transforms.gem_to_hash(api_response_chunk.usage)&.compact
+          if delta_usage.present?
+            message_stack.last[:usage] = (message_stack.last[:usage] || {}).merge(delta_usage)
+            record_stream_usage(message_stack.last[:usage])
+          end
+
         # Message Completed [Full Message]
         when :message_stop
           api_message = Anthropic::Transforms.gem_to_hash(api_response_chunk.message)

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require "test_helper"
+require_relative "../../../lib/active_agent/providers/anthropic_provider"
+
+module Providers
+  module Anthropic
+    # A streamed generation has no response body, so the token counts have to
+    # be collected from the message_start and message_delta events.
+    class StreamingUsageTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+      include WebMock::API
+
+      ENDPOINT = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages"
+
+      def sse
+        message = { id: "msg_1", type: "message", role: "assistant", model: "claude-sonnet-4-5", content: [],
+                    stop_reason: nil, stop_sequence: nil, usage: { input_tokens: 20, output_tokens: 1 } }
+        events = [
+          [ "message_start", { type: "message_start", message: } ],
+          [ "content_block_start", { type: "content_block_start", index: 0, content_block: { type: "text", text: "" } } ],
+          [ "content_block_delta", { type: "content_block_delta", index: 0, delta: { type: "text_delta", text: "Hello" } } ],
+          [ "content_block_stop", { type: "content_block_stop", index: 0 } ],
+          [ "message_delta", { type: "message_delta", delta: { stop_reason: "end_turn", stop_sequence: nil }, usage: { output_tokens: 6 } } ],
+          [ "message_stop", { type: "message_stop" } ]
+        ]
+
+        events.map { |name, data| "event: #{name}\ndata: #{data.to_json}\n\n" }.join
+      end
+
+      test "a streamed generation reports its token usage" do
+        stub_request(:post, ENDPOINT)
+          .to_return(status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type" => "text/event-stream" }, body: sse)
+
+        response = ActiveAgent::Providers::AnthropicProvider.new(
+          service: "Anthropic",
+          model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
+          api_key: "test-key",
+          stream: true,
+          messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Hi" } ],
+          stream_broadcaster: ->(_message, _delta, _event_type) { }
+        ).prompt
+
+        assert_not_nil response.usage
+        assert_equal 20, response.usage.input_tokens
+        assert_equal 6, response.usage.output_tokens
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end
